figures.alt: Vertical clear shower-door side seal meeting an even tiled jamb gap
figures.caption: Door seals work only when the door and jamb meet evenly. Check the bottom sweep, vertical seals, threshold, and frame as one water-control path.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Clear shower-door bottom sweep aligned above a tile threshold
figures.caption: Old residue has to be removed and the new sweep trimmed to fit without bowing or leaving an opening at either bottom corner.

figures.alt: Bathroom floor and shower threshold prepared for careful wet-area finish work
figures.caption: At the lower corners, tile joints and sealant condition affect where water travels. After a test shower, persistent leakage may point to frame or curb repairs.
